rule: S_N must not be null
rationale: S_N serves as a one-to-one join key with Cust_Bio_dirty and is the primary identifier for records. Missing values would break referential integrity.

rule: S_N must be unique across all records
rationale: Evidence shows this is designated as a one-to-one key, yet one value ('3') appears twice. Duplicate keys violate the one-to-one constraint with Cust_Bio_dirty.

rule: Every S_N in Acc_Info_dirty must exist in Cust_Bio_dirty.S_N
rationale: Explicit join hint indicates one-to-one relationship. Referential integrity must be maintained between the two tables.

rule: Account_No must not be null
rationale: Account number is a critical business identifier for subscription accounts. No missing values observed in sample, indicating mandatory field.

rule: Account_No must be exactly 4 digits
rationale: Evidence shows values are always 4 characters long, ranging from 1001-1028. Must conform to 4-digit numeric format.

rule: Account_No must be unique
rationale: Described as near-unique with duplicates observed for values 1001 and 1010. Account numbers should uniquely identify accounts.

rule: Full_Name must not be null
rationale: Personal identification field with 0% missing values in sample. Required for account ownership identification.

rule: Full_Name must follow title case convention except for recognized lowercase particles (bin, binte, d/o, s/o)
rationale: Sample shows 5 records with lowercase deviations (junrong, irfan, Lee yixuan, Hui Min tan). Standard naming convention uses title case.

check_params.logic: any(w[0].islower() for w in str(row['Full_Name']).split() if w.lower() not in ('bin','binte','d/o','s/o') and len(w) > 1 and w[0].isalpha())

rule: Full_Name must not contain consecutive whitespace (double spaces)
rationale: Evidence shows excess whitespace in 'Ramesh s/o  Govindasamy'. Names should use single spaces between components.

rule: ID must not be null
rationale: Government identification number (Singapore NRIC format). No missing values observed and serves as unique identifier.

rule: ID must follow Singapore NRIC format: one letter prefix (S/T/F/G), 7 digits, and one uppercase checksum letter
rationale: 96.7% of values follow aXXXXXXXa format. One value 'S123456' uses truncated 7-character format lacking checksum suffix and must be flagged.

rule: Every ID in Acc_Info_dirty must exist in Cust_Bio_dirty.ID_No
rationale: ID represents the same government identifier as ID_No in the bio table. Cross-table consistency required for identity verification.

rule: JoinDate must not be null
rationale: Account creation date is a mandatory temporal attribute for subscription lifecycle analysis. 3.3% missing values observed indicates data quality issue requiring flagging.

rule: JoinDate must be a parseable date string
rationale: Column stored as string but intended as datetime. Evidence shows one unparseable value '2025-13-01' (invalid month 13).

rule: JoinDate must not be in the future
rationale: Join date is a historical field representing when account was created. Sample contains future date '2027-01-15' which violates temporal integrity.

rule: LastLogin must not be null
rationale: Last login timestamp is required for activity tracking and churn analysis. No missing values observed in sample.

rule: LastLogin must be a parseable date string
rationale: Stored as string but intended as datetime. Must conform to 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' format for proper temporal analysis.

rule: LastLogin must not be in the future
rationale: Last login is a historical activity marker. Future dates would indicate data corruption or system errors.

rule: JoinDate must be on or before LastLogin
rationale: Logical temporal constraint: account cannot be last accessed before it was created. Sample shows one violation where LastLogin (2019-01-01) precedes JoinDate (2020-11-02).

rule: Subscription_Type must not be null
rationale: Critical business categorization field with 0% missing values. Required for subscription analytics and billing logic.

rule: Subscription_Type must be one of: Basic, Free, Gold, Platinum, Premium
rationale: Categorical field with 5 observed distinct values. Must conform to valid subscription tier taxonomy.

rule: SubscriptionFee must not be null
rationale: Monetary value required for revenue analysis. 6.7% missing values observed indicates data quality issue requiring investigation.

rule: SubscriptionFee must be numeric or the literal 'free' (case insensitive)
rationale: Column stored as string but intended as float64. Evidence shows non-numeric value 'free' and placeholder '99999'. This rule flags values that are neither parseable as numbers nor the explicit 'free' text.

rule: SubscriptionFee must not contain sentinel placeholder value 99999
rationale: Evidence identifies '99999' as a statistical outlier appearing sentinel-coded for missing or invalid subscription fee data.

rule: SubscriptionFee must be non-negative
rationale: Subscription fees represent monetary charges and should not be negative. Negative values would indicate data entry errors or system corruption.

rule: If Subscription_Type is 'Free', SubscriptionFee must be 0 or null
rationale: Business logic constraint: Free tier subscriptions should not incur charges. Non-zero fees for Free tier indicate categorization errors or billing system issues.

check_params.logic: row['Subscription_Type'] == 'Free' and pd.notna(pd.to_numeric(row['SubscriptionFee'], errors='coerce')) and pd.to_numeric(row['SubscriptionFee'], errors='coerce') != 0

rule: Status must not be null
rationale: Boolean status indicator required for account state management. No missing values observed.

rule: Status must use the dominant boolean representations True or False
rationale: Column intended as boolean but stored as string with inconsistent encoding across 6 observed formats. Values outside this set are invalid.

rule: AccountBalance must not be null
rationale: Financial field representing account funds. 0% missing values indicates mandatory field for financial tracking.

rule: AccountBalance must not contain sentinel placeholder value 99999.0
rationale: Evidence identifies 99999.0 as a statistical outlier significantly exceeding expected range (upper bound 1525), appearing sentinel-coded for missing/invalid data.

rule: AccountBalance negative values require verification
rationale: Column shows predominantly positive values with one negative value (-150.5). While negative balances (overdrafts) may be valid business cases, they require explicit confirmation as they are sign-anomalous.

rule: PreferredLanguage must not be null
rationale: Communication preference required for localization and customer outreach. No missing values observed.

rule: PreferredLanguage must be one of: English, French, German, Malay, Tamil
rationale: Categorical field with 5 observed distinct language values representing Singapore's official languages. Must conform to supported language set.

rule: Device must not be null
rationale: Platform categorization required for device analytics. No missing values observed.

rule: Device must be one of: Desktop, Mobile, Tablet
rationale: Categorical field with 3 observed device types. Must conform to valid device taxonomy.

rule: OS must not be null
rationale: Operating system identifier required for platform support and compatibility tracking. No missing values observed.

rule: OS must be one of the canonical values: Android, iOS, Linux, Windows, macOS
rationale: Evidence shows casing inconsistencies (android, IOS, LINUX, macOs). Must standardize to official brand casing per recommended actions.

rule: FeedbackScore must not be null
rationale: Customer satisfaction metric required for quality analysis. No missing values observed.

rule: FeedbackScore must be between 1.0 and 5.0 inclusive
rationale: Domain constraint: Feedback scores typically use 1-5 scale. Evidence shows value 7.3 exceeds this range and appears sentinel-coded or erroneous.

rule: FeedbackScore1 must not be null
rationale: Duplicate satisfaction metric (81.25% resemblance to FeedbackScore). No missing values observed.

rule: FeedbackScore1 must be between 1.0 and 5.0 inclusive
rationale: Domain constraint: Valid range 1-5 based on observed maximum and business logic for rating scales.

rule: FeedbackScore and FeedbackScore1 must be equal
rationale: Columns exhibit 81.25% value resemblance suggesting they represent the same metric. Discrepancies (e.g., 7.3 vs 2.65, 2.87 vs 4.11 in sample) indicate data synchronization errors or corruption.

rule: Malay/Indian name particles in Full_Name must match Gender from Cust_Bio_dirty: Bin/s/o indicates Male, Binte/d/o indicates Female
rationale: Cultural naming convention validation: Malay 'Bin' (son of) and Indian 's/o' (son of) particles indicate male gender; 'Binte' and 'd/o' (daughter of) indicate female gender. Cross-reference with Cust_Bio_dirty.Gender ensures demographic consistency.

check_params.semantic_check: Male gender must correspond to Bin or s/o particles in Full_Name; Female gender must correspond to Binte or d/o particles
